lines.en: I skim the crests of the waves.
Wings spread, I am over four metres across.
I glide just above the sea.
My wingtips nearly touch the water.
My long beak sweeps downward.

lines.zh: 巴西的早白垩海，我记得。
lines.en: I remember the early Cretaceous sea off Brazil.
I drop low, searching for fish.
A gust lifts me.
I circle the rocks.
My wing membrane glints in the sun.
I drift toward the shore.
Landing on the cliff, I fold my wings.
I bank into the air current.
There is a glimmer of fish on the water.
I rest on the cliff top.
The sea wind keeps at me.
The teeth in my beak are fine.
I wait for the surface to stir.
There is an old tear in my wing.
I tilt my head at the waves.
The water below is too bright.
I open one wing slowly.
There is wind enough here.
I stare into the distance.
Salt crusts on my beak.
I do not beat my wings once.
Sea birds keep their distance.
I fold my wings in again.
You are on the cliff edge.
I wheel in circles above you.

lines.zh: 你手上那件东西很显眼。
lines.en: That thing in your hand stands out.
Your size is nothing much.
One dive and I am there.
Stand firm. I am coming down.
I am not just sunning myself.
Behind you is the sea.
My beak is sharp.
Lower that weapon.
I am watching how you move.
From this height, one dive is enough.
I shriek.
My wing went crooked.
I retreat to the cliff edge.
Another tear in the membrane.
Blood drips on the rock.
I can still fly.
The wind helped a little.
I shake my wing feathers.
This wound is not heavy.
This one, I will not forget.
Fish? Throw it up.
I caught that smell.
This one is too small.
I will come down for it.
Do not throw it too far.
I catch it in one snap.
Is there more in the water.
Are you waiting for me to take it myself?
Not one mouthful for me.
My wings are folded.
I knock your shoulder loose.
A wing bone hits with a crack.
I am flung back a stretch.
You are much heavier.
I steadied in the air.
The membrane is crumpled.
I bank around and come back.
The ledge is too narrow.
I angle aside.
One more pass.
I call from the cliff.
There is an answer.
Two shadows fly together.
We ride the same updraft.
The nest belongs high up.
Do not hit the cliff.
I fly on your inner side.
The sea is far below.
Keep the tail steady.
Fly level, side by side.
I dive and snatch it.
I catch it in midair.
It is hard enough to jar my beak.
I open my claws and let it fall.
I can fish up what is in the water.
This is no fish.
Two bites.
This one is somewhat big.
I fly with it.
It fell back into the water.
You moved half a step.
I turn above you.
My wings are half folded.
You are the one I have locked on.
I am ready to dive.
My long beak lines up on you.
The sea wind cannot stop me.
I drive you onto the cliff's rim.
This lunge will land.
I am diving down.
Do not tip your head up.
Three seconds.
I fold my wings and aim downward.
This very breath.
Circle by circle, I drop lower.

lines.zh: 你每走一步我都看得见。
lines.en: I see every step you take.
I drop lower.
The wind is off the sea.
You are between two rocks.
I circle, looking for an opening.
My wingtip passes your head.
The wing shadow draws nearer.
Your feet have stopped.
I hear you catch your breath.
I will go lower this circuit.
You are looking up for me.
I switch to the other side.
Almost ready.
Down goes this one.
The long beak stabs down.
My claws rake across your shoulder.
You are knocked aside.
I use the wind to lunge again.
My wing sweeps across your shoulder.
Something slipped from your hand.
My fine teeth open a gash.
That lunge went wide.
I climb again.
I turn back and come down.
I land behind you.
My beak sinks into your shoulder.
You caught the beak.
Stab once more.
The wind on the shore has strengthened.
A new shadow appears on the cliff.
I fly out of the sea mist.
My wings span four or five metres.
I settle on the rock.
The early Cretaceous wind is the same.
Salt has not dried on my beak.
I circle once.
My shadow shows on the sea.
I fold my wings to my ribs.
There is nothing else below.
I spread my wing membrane to dry.
I am looking for somewhere to land.
The wind pushed me onto the cliff.
I look down and scan you.
This is good for diving.
I fold my wings in.
I gave a sharp cry.
Heat hit my wings and I pulled away.
I fell below the cliff and hit stone.
I came down in the sea, unable to spread my wings.
The blast rolls me over.
Something pierced my wing membrane.
This light threw off my direction.
There are no schools of fish at sea.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面，我立刻升高。
lines.en: Lightning hit the sea and I climbed at once.
No wind here, and no sea.
